scope: ISO 32000-2:2020 clause 7.4.9 verified against the locally supplied reference; codec algorithms independently implemented for the stated ISO/IEC 15444-1 subset. Annex locators refer to Part 1.

requirements.codec_reference: ISO/IEC 15444-1, Annex A; B; C; D
requirements.status: Part 1 MQ code-blocks, tag trees, reset and segmentation symbols; signed 1-16-bit components
requirements.gaps: Bypass, terminate-each-pass, predictable termination, vertical-causal coding, ROI shifts and partial bit-plane quality truncation return Unsupported.

requirements.status: Reversible 5/3 synthesis with reference-grid parity, symmetric extension and singleton dimensions
requirements.gaps: Component precision above 16 bits and coefficient precision above 30 bit planes exceed the current representation.

requirements.status: All five progression orders with one default precinct per resolution and multiple layers
requirements.gaps: Explicit non-default precinct partitioning, multiple precincts per resolution, POC and PPM/PPT return Unsupported.

requirements.status: Inverse reversible component transform and DC level shift
Tile grids and packet-boundary tile-parts, assembled without partial success
requirements.gaps: Coding parameter changes after the first tile-part return Unsupported.

requirements.status: 9/7 lifting, expounded and derived scalar dequantization, ICT; input sample oracle with tolerance 3
requirements.gaps: Floating-point reconstruction; no bit-exact lossy output claim.

requirements.status: JP2 bounds, ihdr, colr methods 1-3, cdef, res and extended box lengths
requirements.gaps: Multiple colour specifications need negotiation. Premultiplied, partial and per-colour opacity definitions require a richer public image API. ICC profile bytes are preserved, not interpreted.

requirements.status: JP2 palette and component mapping, applied before channel definitions
requirements.gaps: Palette and component precision limited to 16 bits.

requirements.status: Truncations, tag-tree precision, impossible tile counts and box lengths fail with bounded work
requirements.gaps: No recovery or invented pixels; allocation accounting conservatively includes temporary buffers.
